family.definition: one economic history: generator, profile, seed and configuration without defect switches
family.error_variant: generator snapshot with the ordered defects
family.clean_variant: private/source_book of the same snapshot with an empty truth
independence: the defect-bearing counterparty->invoice->payments chain occurs in no other family or split

holdout.full_omission: generated as a separate sealed supplement after #40 is accepted; the holdout is not final before that

failure.persistent: same failure kind in >=2 of 3 repetitions on a validated episode
failure.reduction_accepted: reduced episode validated, same defect kind, same failure kind in >=2 of 3 new repetitions; all repetitions published

metrics.micro_f1: 2*sumTP/(2*sumTP+sumFP+sumFN) over all attempts of a variant
metrics.mean_reward: mean of return over all attempts, including timeouts and errors
metrics.fp_on_clean: share of clean-variant attempts with >=1 finding; number of FP findings
metrics.completion: share of attempts with an accepted submit
metrics.scoring_rules: official fintech-checks 2026-11-20; reviewer reference scorer; evidence availability; tau from policy

exclusions: only reviewer-side infrastructure failure before the agent's first action; one retry; both recorded. Timeouts, provider errors and invalid answers are agent results scored by the official rule.

statistics.family_value: mean over its episodes and repetitions

primary.E2: accepted persistent failures per unit budget

statistics.decision: effect not shown if the interval contains 0; null and negative effects are published

cost_estimate.status: estimate; prices and limit fixed by the integrator before any paid run
